title: ADA Analysis Laboratory
description: ADA laboratory or facility building block. Extends the core CDIF spatialExtent (schema:Place) with NeXus NXsource classification via additionalType. Inherits place name, identifier, alternateName, geo coordinates, and geosparql geometry from spatialExtent.

schema:additionalType.description: Must classify the place as a NeXus NXsource. The value is a sealed reference ({"@id": ...}) so JSON-LD expands it to a real IRI; written as a bare string it stays a literal that looks like a URI and resolves to nothing. The two-segment path is the form that actually resolves -- .../classes/BaseClass/NXsource is a 404, .../classes/base_classes/NXsource.html is not.
